It's pretty simple man, if you don't up your caloric intake, it won't happen.

You don't need to eat till you drop, you can just up your intake marginally, you're standing still as is, so everything you do from here on out is muscle mass gained right?

A meal every 2 hours is very good, and it doesn't have to be a huge meal.

Up at least until 2300 calories for now with a 40/40/20 split (carbs/proteins/fats), and see where it gets you in 6-8 weeks, then re-evaluate

Protein shakes are useful in general, but don't overestimate them, every protein your body doesn't need is just processed out of your body. Ideally you take in about1.7 grams of protein per kilogram of bodyweight per day for strength training. Also, proteins make sure your body is constantly burning fuel, so in your case, it might be less then desirable, as you have to gain weight to build muscle.

You would be better helped by adding some potatoes or bread to your diet at this point,
